summary.text: The Ghirapur Grand Prix is a death-defying interplanar circuit race, begun as an illegal street race on Avishkar, whose champion wins the Aetherspark.

bio.text: The chaotic inaugural Grand Prix, the first multiplanar race, crossed nearly two dozen planes, some teams were killed or lost, and Kylem's Cloudspire Racing Team won.
The Avishkar Assembly then expanded the event beyond Avishkar to invite teams from many planes as an annual festival.
The second Grand Prix was held around 4564 AR across Amonkhet and Muraganda with the Aetherspark as grand prize, and Gonti fired the signal flare to start it.
The race crossed Amonkhet and Muraganda, where racers were hindered by giant dinosaurs and Saurid raiders, before returning to Ghirapur.
All teams reached the final stage despite hazards and a dragonstorm, but a revanchist coup by former Consulate members trapped many racers, and the coup failed and Mohar was jailed.
Zahur crossed the finish line first, winning the Aetherspark.

status.text: The second Grand Prix has ended, with Zahur winning the Aetherspark, and the Avishkar Assembly plans to keep the race going as a festival.
